title: proven-by-is-demanded-at-proved-and-askable-only-earlier
author: CC
owner: CC builds it; cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master owns the clearance gate
intention: The clearance gate refuses PROVED with [proof_named] when no crossing since BUILDME carries proven_by — but PROVED is the LAST crossing, and by the time the lack is named the crossing that should have carried the proof is already journaled and append-only. The only repair is a back-edge into the record of truth. Name the lack where it can still be supplied: the PROVEME crossing, which is the crossing that claims the build is proved, must refuse without proven_by.
why: The record of truth is append-only by design (Law 7), so a gate that can only be satisfied by editing history is a gate that teaches builders to edit history. Measured this session: satisfying it took a back-edge to PROVEME, a commit, a forward re-cross, and a second commit — four acts and two extra journal entries, none of which say anything about the build. The information was available at PROVEME and nothing asked for it.
how: Fire the same _coverage_lacks predicate the PROVED rung uses (clearance.py:1340) at the PROVEME crossing, restricted to the [proof_named] lack alone — hollow evidence legitimately cannot exist yet at PROVEME, so [hollow_evidence_absent] must stay where it is. My read, NOT ruled: PROVEME demands a named proof, PROVED keeps both lacks, and the PROVED [proof_named] check becomes the backstop it was always meant to be rather than the first time anyone asks. Also check whether emit's own PROVEME arm is the right site rather than the clearance machine, since PROVEME today rides bare emit while PROVED rides clear().
falsifier: DONE when a PROVEME crossing carrying no proven_by is refused by name, the refusal says which argument is missing, and a voyage that supplies it at PROVEME reaches PROVED without any back-edge. WRONG INTENT if the answer is to let PROVED accept a proof named on the clear() call alone — proven_by is journal-derived on purpose (crossings.py:242 proven_by_since_buildme), because a proof named only in an argument leaves no record for the hollow check to read, and hollow reads the journal.
traces_to: Law 7 (the record of truth is permanent — a gate whose only repair is a back-edge turns an append-only journal into an editable one); Law 1 (the resolver is spent on the novel — four acts to supply one already-known fact); Law 4 (the rule is real physics already; its FIRING POINT is the defect).
watchme: none, because the falsifier is checkable deterministically at the gate itself and the next voyage through PROVEME is its own live fire; a probe would watch for back-edges, which is the symptom rather than the rule.
gates_bound: proof gate — a proof beside the harbor_master that crosses a fixture voyage to PROVEME without proven_by and asserts the refusal; it must pass against today's code by NOT being refused, so the tooth reds until the fix lands.
feeds back to origin on failure — a red routes to this ticket's own voyage.
durability gate — not done until proven AND committed.
children: none, because it is one predicate fired at one more place

measured_at_cast.reading_1: clear(..., 'PROVED') raised Uncovered with 2 lacks: [proof_named] 'the ticket has crossings and none carries proven_by' and [hollow_evidence_absent] 'no hollow reading'.
measured_at_cast.reading_2: the PROVEME crossing had already been emitted without proven_by and nothing refused it.
measured_at_cast.reading_3: PROVEME -> PROVEME is IllegalTransition ('a no-op at position 3'), so a back-edge cannot be repaired by re-crossing to the same summons; the evidence has to ride the NEXT forward crossing, which in this voyage was WATCHME.
measured_at_cast.reading_4: clearance.py:1296 builds _named from clear()'s own proven_by argument, while cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py reads crossings.proven_by_since_buildme — two different sources for the same fact, which is why naming a proof at clear() alone did not satisfy hollow.

found_while: sailing 548dd13fb4db. Cast under Akien's standing instruction, 2026-09-11: 'Follow the cairn workflow (reds found along the way are ticketed)'.
sorted_berth: none, because a bug enters directly as a ticket — /intent's own SKILL.md: 'Do not route a bug through here: if editing lines of code fixes it, it is a ticket'. Node class CairnCommons/node_classes/bug.json.
intent_berth: none, because a bug enters directly as a ticket — see sorted_berth.

decisions.text: The check sits in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py emit(), in the forward arm where target == 'PROVEME' and target_idx > wf.cursor, placed BEFORE the entry-gate re-run at that crossing so a caller hears the cheapest lack first; it fires only when journal_extra names a ticket (journal_extra.get('ticket') is not None) — a ticketless crossing journals the lane as 'not_checked', the same v0 jurisdiction the entry gate uses. PROVED's clearance rung (clearance.py _coverage_lacks) is untouched: [proof_named] and [hollow_evidence_absent] both stay there as the backstop.
decisions.step: unlisted: the site of the check

decisions.text: The predicate is the UNION the record will read: cairn.tools.base.crossings.proven_by_since_buildme(ticket) plus this crossing's own journal_extra['proven_by'] normalised to a list (a str is one path, a list is many, None/'' is none). Empty union -> raise ProofNamedRed(IllegalTransition) — a new sibling of EntryGateRed/BuildGateRed/ExitGateRed, never a subclass — whose message names the missing argument verbatim: 'proven_by'. Nothing is written before the raise.

A new inspect_proof_named(ticket, journal_extra) -> list[dict] in transitions.py returns one lane named the_proveme_crossing_names_its_proof (via _lane, code 'transitions.py::inspect_proof_named') with expected/actual text and values {'named': [...], 'since_buildme': [...]}; the lane is appended to the crossing's proved list in every outcome (pass, refusal, not_checked), so a gate that stops running makes the record SHORTER (Akien 2026-08-13: no empty anywhere).

Proof at cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py, module-level PROVES = {'7203db7f151e': {'all': 'test_a_proveme_crossing_without_a_proof_is_refused_by_name'}} (the falsifier is one unnumbered clause, so one composite tooth). The tooth binds ProofNamedRed and inspect_proof_named at call time via getattr (so a hollow reversion of transitions.py reds the tooth rather than crashing the runner), drives emit() over a tmp history/state pair with workflow 'bug@v1: THINKME -> TICKETME -> [BUILDME] -> PROVEME -> PROVED' and a fixture ticket id no journal carries: (a) no proven_by -> ProofNamedRed whose message contains 'proven_by' and the ticket id, and the history file is unchanged; (b) proven_by='cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py' -> whatever is raised is NOT ProofNamedRed and inspect_proof_named's lane reads expected == actual; (c) ticket=None -> the lane reads not_checked. Runner: if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(print_teeth_main(__file__)).

Validation: cairn/tools/base/validations/test_proveme_names_its_proof.json, sealed by PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m cairn.devices.tester.cli --hollow 7203db7f151e --seal --timeout 600 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py after the BUILDME crossing is journaled. The 'reaches PROVED without any back-edge' half of the falsifier is the live fire: this ticket's own voyage crosses PROVEME carrying proven_by=cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py and then PROVED through harbor_master.clearance.clear, and the verdict cites that crossing.
decisions.step: unlisted: the seal and the live fire

decisions.text: No exemption roster, no widening: _require_named_ticket, _entry_gate, the exit gate, and clearance.py are byte-identical before and after (git diff on those functions is empty). Back-edges into or out of PROVEME stay ungated. The existing proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_transitions.py is not edited (it carries uncommitted work of ticket 77f15efd5a96).

The seat sits in emit()'s forward target == 'PROVEME' arm AFTER the entry-gate block at that same crossing (the entry gate asks whether the build was charted, this seat asks whether it is proven, and in the voyage the chart comes first — a builder wrong about both hears EntryGateRed first; ProofNamedRed fires only for a charted build). It fires only when journal_extra['ticket'] is not None. A ticketless PROVEME crossing records proof_gate: 'not_checked' and appends NO lane — exactly the entry gate's v0 jurisdiction, which appends no lane for a ticketless BUILDME->PROVEME crossing (test_transitions.py::test_every_journaled_crossing_carries_the_record_of_what_it_proved pins the ticketless record to the three inspect_rules lanes). This supersedes D1's 'placed BEFORE the entry-gate re-run' and D3's 'not_checked' lane.
decisions.step: unlisted: the site of the check

decisions.text: One lane, identity the_proveme_crossing_names_its_proof, built by _lane with code transitions.py::inspect_proof_named and values {'ticket','named','since_buildme'}; appended to the crossing's proved list on PASS and on REFUSAL (the raise carries it as findings). It is NOT appended for a ticketless crossing — that crossing carries only the proof_gate: 'not_checked' field on the record, so the existing exact-identity assertion over ticketless records stays green without editing test_transitions.py (D6).

Under D7 the real entry gate refuses a chartless fixture ticket before the seat is reached, so legs (a) and (b) run with transitions._entry_gate replaced (setattr, restored in finally) by a stub returning ('clean — fixture chart', []) and transitions._stamp_sail replaced by a no-op (a fixture ticket must not claim the live sail record in instance-space); the seat itself, ProofNamedRed, inspect_proof_named and the history write are all REAL. Leg (b) asserts emit returns a string whose cursor stands at PROVEME, the journaled record's proof_gate starts with 'clean — proof named:' and its proved list carries exactly one lane the_proveme_crossing_names_its_proof with expected == actual. Leg (c) supersedes D4's wording: ticket=None -> emit succeeds with the real gates, the record's proof_gate == 'not_checked', and NO lane of that identity is in proved. proven_by_since_buildme reads the live journal for the fixture id and must return [] (the invariant that no journal carries it).
